name: fairbuild-payment-release
description: Fairbuild Payment Release: the release check before a subcontractor is paid: project manager approval, the owner paid for that month (pay-when-paid, if you use it), a conditional lien waiver for the invoice, a current insurance certificate, a W-9 on file and retainage withheld at the subcontract rate. Each invoice is cleared or held with its reasons, and payment releases are recorded only after one named person's click. Never pays.
